notes.title: These notes cover the Update 1 for Ludovischi Survivors.
notes.notes:
[b]These notes cover the Update 1 for Ludovischi Survivors.[/b]
1 Added graphics, sound, language, and challenging survival mode settings. 
2 The balance of gaining experience, monster health, and their number has been completely redesigned. 
3 The character Alex has been added to the game, this will be the third playable character.
4 The durability of unlocking characters for coins that are collected during the battle has been redesigned. 
5 Added a new character leveling system called blessing. Now, in non-combat mode, you can increase the characteristics of the characters by receiving blessings on the profile screen.

notes.title: Ludovischi Survivors | Update 1 Release
notes.notes:
[b]Ludovischi Survivors | Update 1 Release[/b]
These notes cover the Update 1 for Ludovischi Survivors.
[b]	Recycling settings[/b]
Added graphics, sound, language, and challenging survival mode settings. 
[b]	Balance edits[/b]
The balance of gaining experience, monster health, and their number has been completely redesigned. 
    [b]A character has been added.[/b]
The character Alex has been added to the game, this will be the third playable character.
[b]	For lack of an unblocking balance.[/b]
The durability of unlocking characters for coins that are collected during the battle has been redesigned. 
[b]	Pumping[/b]
Added a new character leveling system called blessing. Now, in non-combat mode, you can increase the characteristics of the characters by receiving blessings on the profile screen.
